title: Image-generation runner
acceptance: Registered runner drives the runtime recorded in F-021-T06 (A: Ollama image generation, else B: ComfyUI with one committed pinned workflow) on loopback with no redirect, proxy or credentials, fixed seed and size, loading the generator and unloading it before the judge
The runner records model digest, seed, size, steps and image SHA-256 per result
Contract tests with a fixture generator, written failing first; no real model and no download in CI; real runs only on an explicit request, marked costly
privacy: Neutral invented cases and fixtures only; no consumer data, private reports or credentials in Git.
validation: Failing pack test first; fixture for each acceptance item; npm test; npm run check:index; CI
escalation: No knowledge of any consumer; a consumer-specific need goes to that consumer's backlog
Material scope or effort growth goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 in the domain-packs plan (owner request) at observed agent speed for one-PR pack steps. Not a measurement. Re-planned 2026-11-26 to the owner's decision; 3 h holds for runtime A, add 1 to 2 h for B.
